stemMd: The discussion of overlapping individual performance chiefly

options.label: A
options.textMd: shows that the group mean could not have been calculated.

options.label: B
options.textMd: proves the retrieval group did not improve on average.

options.label: C
options.textMd: limits how a group-level advantage should be generalized.

options.label: D
options.textMd: establishes the superiority of every rereading participant.

options.label: E
options.textMd: provides the only evidence about the classification task.

explanationMd: The author uses individual variability to distinguish an average effect from a rule applying to every participant.

distractorRationale.d: The stated overlap supports no universal superiority.
distractorRationale.a: Means remain calculable despite overlapping individual scores.
distractorRationale.b: Overlap does not negate the average difference.
